feed.title: Special Town Meeting, November 17, 2026 — Lunenburg Budget Project
feed.subtitle: Every article on the warrant, and where each one stands.

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, November 17, 2026: Select Board, 2026-10-20
entry.summary: Include Article 11, continuity of trust fund administration during vacancy — failed 0-5

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, November 17, 2026: Finance Committee, 2026-10-08
entry.summary: Next meeting will mainly be the public hearing on the warrant, and a DLS education session will be scheduled.

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, November 17, 2026: School Committee, 2026-10-07
entry.summary: Request $300,000 in free cash for the special education reserve fund if certified at the November town meeting, via the warrant article already voted — passed unanimously (roll call)

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, November 17, 2026: Conservation Commission, 2026-10-07
entry.summary: Plan to bring a custodian/caretaker for the Hollis Road house onto the town payroll through a town meeting article, then seek applicants.

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, November 17, 2026: Select Board, 2026-10-06
entry.summary: Include the non-binding question on TC Passios demolition in the warrant — passed unanimously

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, November 17, 2026: Lunenburg Municipal Building Design Committee, 2026-10-05
entry.summary: No article will be submitted for the November town meeting; the chair will tell the select board it is premature.

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, November 17, 2026: Board of Assessors, 2026-09-30
entry.summary: Put the warrant article for clause 22J (doubling veterans exemptions) on the town warrant. — not audible

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, November 17, 2026: Select Board, 2026-09-29
entry.summary: Special town meeting articles: TC Pacios

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, November 17, 2026: Finance Committee, 2026-09-24
entry.summary: Warrant articles will get an in-depth discussion on October 8, a public hearing on October 22, ahead of a special town meeting planned for November 17.

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, November 17, 2026: Board of Assessors, 2026-09-23
entry.summary: Table discussion of the veterans exemption warrant article/clause language until the board can meet with the chair (Brian Lafond) — passed

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, November 17, 2026: Personnel Committee, 2026-09-21
entry.summary: The personnel committee bylaws will stay as is, because the special town meeting warrant deadline was missed; work continues for a later town meeting.

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, November 17, 2026: School Committee, 2026-09-16
entry.summary: Request the town raise/appropriate/borrow funds for a full feasibility and schematic study of the turf field, track, drainage and retaining wall, as a placeholder warrant article — passed 5-0 (all yes on roll call)

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, November 17, 2026: , 2026-09-16
entry.summary: Recommend the warrant article for the November Special Town Meeting: Proposed Budget Increase for FY '27 (salary increase of $23,500.00 for the remainder of FY '27, funded from retained earnings). — not stated

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, November 17, 2026: Select Board, 2026-09-15
entry.summary: Refer Special Town Meeting articles on Corrective Zoning Amendments and Stormwater Management Bylaw Fee Structure to the Planning Board for review and public hearing — passed 5-0

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, November 17, 2026: Stormwater Task Force, 2026-09-14
entry.summary: Accept the warrant article for special town meeting with the changes from town counsel — passed (roll call: Jenny I, Renee I, John I, Tim I)

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, November 17, 2026: , 2026-09-14
entry.summary: Forward collective zoning amendments article to the Select Board as Article 1 — passed 5-0

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, November 17, 2026: Trust Fund Commission, 2026-09-10
entry.summary: Approve the rewritten warrant article on continuity of trust fund administration during a vacancy on the board, as amended per the lawyer's comments, for submission to the select board/town meeting warrant — passed unanimously (2-0), roll call: John Bowen aye, Richard Howard aye

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, November 17, 2026: School Committee, 2026-09-09
entry.summary: Skip the agenda item to vote on the warrant articles from the 9/3/26 town meeting, since that vote was already taken at town meeting — passed

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, November 17, 2026: Board of Assessors, 2026-09-09
entry.summary: A placeholder will be requested for a veterans' exemption increase warrant article for the November 17th special town meeting, with research to be discussed at the September 23rd meeting.

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, November 17, 2026: Stormwater Task Force, 2026-09-08
entry.summary: Agenda to include approval for the town meeting warrant under ongoing business and review of the abatement process write-up.

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, November 17, 2026: Sewer Commission, 2026-09-08
entry.summary: To accept the warrant article wording authorizing a Comprehensive Procurement for Sewer Pump Station Operation, Maintenance, Emergency Services and Construction Capital repair work — passed 3-0

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, November 17, 2026: Public Access Cable Committee (PACC), 2026-09-08
entry.summary: Allow PACC to work with J.Toale to prepare and submit a warrant, including the new budget projections, for the November Special Town Meeting. — passed

entry.title: Special Town Meeting, November 17, 2026: Select Board, 2026-08-18
entry.summary: Approve the draft schedule for the November 17, 2026 special town meeting, later amended to cover only the opening of the warrant (Aug 19) and closing of the warrant (Sept 17 at 5:00 p.m.). — passed unanimously
